items.title: Corpay (CPAY) Could Be 9% Undervalued Following Q3 Beat And Higher Guidance
items.summary: Corpay (CPAY) is back in focus after reporting third quarter revenue of US$1.38b and net income of US$378.42m. The company also raised its full-year revenue and earnings guidance for 2026. The strong third quarter has landed on a stock that already had momentum, with a 39.26% year to date share price return and a 59.96% total shareholder return over the past year.
